name: your-move
description: Find your messages. Never miss what Claude is waiting on you for. Borders your own messages and outlines any part of Claude's reply that needs you to act.

your_message_color.title: Your messages: border colour
your_message_color.description: Hex colour of the border around messages you type, e.g. #5b0a91

your_move_color.title: Your move: outline colour
your_move_color.description: Hex colour of the outline around the part of Claude's reply that needs you to act, e.g. #ff2020
